mapper.select: SELECT i.*, f.name as fruit_name, l.name as location_name FROM inventory i JOIN fruits f ON i.fruit_id = f.id JOIN inventory_locations l ON i.location_id = l.id ORDER BY f.name, l.name

SELECT i.*, f.name as fruit_name, l.name as location_name FROM inventory i JOIN fruits f ON i.fruit_id = f.id JOIN inventory_locations l ON i.location_id = l.id WHERE i.quantity <= i.low_stock_threshold ORDER BY i.quantity ASC

SELECT i.*, f.name as fruit_name, l.name as location_name FROM inventory i JOIN fruits f ON i.fruit_id = f.id JOIN inventory_locations l ON i.location_id = l.id WHERE i.fruit_id = #{fruitId} AND i.location_id = #{locationId}
SELECT i.*, f.name as fruit_name, l.name as location_name FROM inventory i JOIN fruits f ON i.fruit_id = f.id JOIN inventory_locations l ON i.location_id = l.id WHERE i.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (fruit_id, location_id, quantity, low_stock_threshold, last_updated) VALUES (#{fruitId}, #{locationId}, #{quantity}, #{lowStockThreshold}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET quantity = #{quantity}, low_stock_threshold = #{lowStockThreshold}, last_updated = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

INSERT INTO inventory (fruit_id, location_id, quantity, low_stock_threshold, last_updated) VALUES (#{fruitId}, #{locationId}, #{quantity}, 10, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + #{quantity}, last_updated = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inventory_locations ORDER BY name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_locations (name, address, description, active, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{address}, #{description}, #{active}, NOW())
